title: GLOBathy, the Global Lakes Bathymetry Dataset (Khazaei et al. 2022, Scientific Data)
reason: Subject of evaluation. Dmax modeled from surrounding-terrain slope + area/perimeter; for 1,468 lakes worldwide (59 fleet lakes) an observed/literature Dmax is supplied. Bathymetry = radial extrapolation from shore, so no real morphology.

title: GLOBathy Bathymetry Rasters (figshare 13404635)
